tmmt: The hero's attacks apply burn with 50% chance for a total of (175% STR) damage. Also applies the flammable state with 30% chance over an area.
tmsc: Attacks trigger chain lightning (8 targets) for 100 damage. Damage is raised by 125% if the target is a hero or a lvl 8+ unit. Cooldown 4 sec.
tret: The hero always respawns with full MP. The death of an enemy hero (by any player) reduces mod cooldown by 20% and raises spell power by 100 for 60 sec.
tsct: On use, summons 4 infernal minions for 30 sec. The hounds grow stronger with every use.
uflg: Dispels units and refreshes non-damaging negative statuses on enemies. Summoned enemies take (150 + 50% spell power) damage. Cooldown 12 sec.
wcyc: Every 6 sec, releases a shockwave at an enemy attacking the hero for 100 + (35% STR) damage.
whwd: On use, fully restores HP and MP and removes all negative effects from the hero. Cooldown 90 sec.
wild: Killing an enemy hero or a lvl 6+ soldier restores 6% HP and raises the hero's attack by 50 and armor by 7 for 12 sec.
will: Reduces non-status damage taken by 10% and converts that damage into MP for the hero.
wlsd: Grants an aura raising allies' armor by 8.
wneg: On use, hits the target with a weighted bolt for (200 + 75% spell power) magic damage and stuns it for 5 sec (2 sec vs heroes).
wneu: Blocks 20 physical damage taken; minimum damage that gets through is 4.
wolg: Blocks 20 physical damage taken; minimum damage that gets through is 4.
woms: On use, restores 325 HP and 325 MP over 10 sec.
wshs: While active, doubles its own stats but drains 1% MP per second; can be switched off.
wswd: Drains 1% MP per second; activating again restores the original stats.
wtlg: Raises the hero's movement speed to its maximum value.
